notes: Sidecar for the open Pick arms (run.py --variant open|labels, grade_open.py); not a runnable suite. run.py asks each open item its stem: the item's own stem if listed below, else its category's. grade_open.py maps a free-form answer to an option key with aliases built in code from each option's label and key (see grade_open.py) plus the synonyms below; escape_phrases map to the item's escape key. Synonyms are our own wording: common names a mission maker would use for the same editor option, never hints taken from the requests.

category_stems.waypoint: Which waypoint type should this be?
category_stems.trigger: Which trigger setting should this be?
category_stems.module: Which no-code module should this use?
category_stems.cutscene: Which cutscene archetype should this be?
category_stems.mood: Which mood preset should this be?
category_stems.routing: Which editor workflow should handle this?

items.stem: Which beat tag fits this node?
Which waypoint type, and synchronised with what?
Which Type should the two triggers have?
Which trigger settings should this have?
